# aeneid-099 — run lead's corrections to the glosser's gloss.json

- `aegri`: the glosser added "also m. dat. pl. (mortālibus aegrīs)"; the dative at 850 is the form *aegris*, not *aegri*. Removed.
- `talin`: *mōnstrum* is neuter, so *tālī* is m./n. abl. sg.; and *-ne* is shortened to *-n*, not elided. Corrected.
- `loricae`: at 924–925 *orasque recludit loricae* the genitive goes with *ōrās*, not *orbēs*. Corrected.
- `importuna`: at 864 it describes the night-bird whose shape the Dira takes, not the Dira. Corrected.
- `obscenae`: at 876 *obscenae volucres* is addressed (*Ne me terrete*): vocative plural. Corrected.
